english:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to <strand/>Strand Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, and Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Max Reserves as additional ammo.

Ammo Bricks from Ammo Finder mods also grant the full bonus.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of your Total Reserves.

source.text:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.
